title: Decoupled Structure-Feature Alignment via Alternating Optimization for Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.11577v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conventional Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) couple feature transformation and neighborhood aggregation, which often renders them vulnerable to topological noise and heterophilous connections. To decouple this dependency, we present a constrained two-view learning framework for robust graph learning, which aligns structure-aware GNN embeddings with a structure-free feature prior. Specifically, the proposed Decoupled Structure-Feature Alternating Learning (DSAL) framework trains an independent anchor network using a self-supervised reconstruction objective to capture the intrinsic semantic information contained in node attributes. Within DSAL, to effectively integrate this prior, we design a channel-split adaptive gated (CSAG) layer. This architecture employs a gating mechanism to balance global spectral smoothing and local spatial representation dynamically. translated_title: 基于交替优化的解耦结构-特征对齐图学习方法
translated_abstract: 传统的图神经网络（GNN）将特征变换与邻域聚合耦合在一起，这往往使其容易受到拓扑噪声和异配连接的影响。为了解耦这种依赖关系，我们提出了一个用于鲁棒图学习的约束双视图学习框架，该框架将结构感知的GNN嵌入与无结构的特征先验进行对齐。具体而言，所提出的解耦结构-特征交替学习（DSAL）框架利用自监督重建目标训练一个独立的锚点网络，以捕获节点属性中蕴含的内在语义信息。在DSAL框架内，为了有效整合该先验，我们设计了一种通道分离自适应门控（CSAG）层。该架构采用门控机制动态平衡全局谱平滑与局部空间表示。此外，该模型通过循环交替过程进行优化（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出DSAL框架，通过自监督锚点网络提取无结构特征先验，并设计通道分离自适应门控层动态平衡全局谱平滑与局部空间表示，再借助交替优化将结构感知的GNN嵌入与该先验对齐，从而提升图学习对拓扑噪声和异配连接的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the DSAL framework, which trains a self-supervised anchor network to provide a structure-free feature prior, employs a channel-split adaptive gated layer to dynamically balance global spectral smoothing and local spatial representation, and uses alternating optimization to align structure-aware GNN embeddings with this prior, thereby enhancing robustness to topological noise and heterophilous connections in graph learning.
